back_translation: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
The word of the LORD came to him in the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

And that word also came in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, until the time when the people of Jerusalem had to go into exile in the fifth month.
The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
"I knew you even before I formed you in the womb, and before you came out from the womb I had set you apart; I appointed you to be a prophet to the nations."
Then I said, "O Lord (my deferential cry to God), behold, I do not know how to speak, for I am only a child."
But the LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am only a child,' for you must go to everyone I send you to, and you must speak everything I command you.
Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you — so declares the LORD.
Then the LORD stretched out His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me, "Behold, I have placed My words in your mouth.
See, this day I have appointed you over the nations and the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant."
The word of the LORD came to me, saying, "Jeremiah, what do you see?" I answered, "I see a branch of an almond tree."
Then the LORD said to me, "You have seen rightly, for I am watching over My word to make it come to pass."
The word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a boiling pot, and its mouth is tilting from the direction of the north."
Then the LORD said to me, "From the north, disaster will be let loose upon all the inhabitants of this land.

Behold, I am about to summon all the clans of the kingdoms of the north — so declares the LORD. They will come, and each will set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will set themselves against all the walls surrounding the city, and against all the cities of Judah.
I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken Me and burned incense offerings to other gods and bowed down to what their own hands have made.
As for you, gird up your loins and be ready; arise and speak to them everything I command you. Do not be terrified because of them, or I will make you terrified before them.

Behold, this day I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls that withstand the whole land — against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the common people of that land.
They will fight against you but will not be able to overcome you, for I am with you to deliver you — so declares the LORD.
